name: Things
longDescription: Create one task or a batch of tasks in Things 3 on macOS through the Things URI scheme. Add notes, start dates, reminders, deadlines, existing tags, checklists, and existing project or heading destinations. Preview a task before sending it. Requires Things 3 for macOS, Things URLs enabled, and a user-provided Things authentication token.
starterPrompts: Add to Things: buy milk tomorrow.
Send these tasks to Things: book the hotel, renew my passport, and buy travel insurance.
Preview a Things task to call the dentist tomorrow at 10:00 without sending it.
releaseNotes: Initial directory candidate for version 1.0.1 with authenticated single-task and batch creation, previews, structured tool results, notes, dates, reminders, deadlines, existing destinations and tags, and checklists.
